name: Filterable Occlusion Maps for Isosurface Ambient Occlusion
definition: A method for rendering isosurfaces with dynamic ambient occlusion and soft shadows at interactive rates by approximating occlusion as the percentage of occluding voxels in a region, using filterable representations (like variance or convolution shadow maps) to quickly extract occluding voxel counts.
summary: Filterable Occlusion Maps render isosurface ambient occlusion interactively by replacing ray casting with statistical approximations, avoiding aliasing and recomputation costs.
